# Crown Point Energy

> Crown Point Energy Inc. (TSXV: CWV) is an Argentine oil & gas company. Its
> Argentine operating subsidiary, Crown Point Energía S.A., is 100% owned by
> Crown Point Energy Inc. and 100% Argentine-owned. The company operates its
> own production across three sedimentary basins in Argentina (Neuquina, San
> Jorge, Cuyana).

This site is bilingual (Spanish/English). Most pages render both languages in
the same HTML and toggle visibility with CSS/a cookie — if you're extracting
text without rendering CSS, expect some duplicated bilingual content in
headings and body copy.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://crownpointenergy.com/): company overview, current
  production/reserves figures, latest material-fact filings.
- [Investors](https://crownpointenergy.com/inversores): financial
  statements, MD&A, investor presentations, ESTMA reports, shareholder
  meeting notices, analyst coverage.
- [Operations](https://crownpointenergy.com/operaciones): operating blocks/
  concessions, acreage, wells, production mix by basin.
- [Press releases](https://crownpointenergy.com/comunicados): news releases,
  also available as [RSS](https://crownpointenergy.com/comunicados/rss.xml).
- [About](https://crownpointenergy.com/acerca): corporate structure, board,
  management, strategy.
- [ESG](https://crownpointenergy.com/esg): environmental, social and
  governance disclosures.
- [Careers](https://crownpointenergy.com/carreras): open positions.
- [Contact](https://crownpointenergy.com/contacto): investor relations and
  general contact information.

## Notes for automated access

- `/portal/*` and `/admin/*` are private, authenticated systems (shareholder
  portal and internal admin) — not part of the public site, disallowed in
  robots.txt, and will not return useful content to an unauthenticated
  request.
- The stock quote widget respects an internal visibility toggle; when hidden,
  `/api/stock/cwv` returns 404 rather than quote data.
- Full sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://crownpointenergy.com/sitemap.xml).
